privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: M. Revi Ramadhan manages this website as an individual, not as a legal entity. You can send all requests about your data to revy8k@gmail.com. We will reply within a reasonable timeframe.
privacy.p2:
When you create an account, you give us your name, email, and profile data (avatar, bio, website, date of birth) that you fill in yourself.
When you fill in the contact form, you give us your name, email, message, and budget (optional).
We also process technical data: login session cookies and basic security logs.
privacy.p3: We process your data to manage access to your account, reply to messages you send, keep the site secure, and display a public profile if you fill it in. We rely on your consent when you submit data, and on our legitimate interest in keeping the service running.
privacy.p4: We keep your account profile data until you delete your account. We keep contact messages until we resolve your inquiry. We keep security logs for up to 90 days.
privacy.p5: We run this site on third-party infrastructure: Supabase for database storage, Vercel for hosting, and identity providers for sign-in (Google OAuth). We do not sell your data or share it for advertising.
privacy.p6: We use session cookies (login) and language preference (NEXT_LOCALE). We do not show ads or track you. If we add an analytics service later, we will ask for your consent first.
privacy.p7: You have the right to request access to, correction of, deletion of, withdrawal of consent for, and portability of your personal data. Send an email to revy8k@gmail.com with a description of your request.
privacy.p8: You can delete your own account on the account settings page (Profile → Delete Account). If you cannot do that or you cannot access your account, email us and we will help you delete it.
privacy.p9: We apply reasonable technical measures: hashed passwords, secure sessions, and limited access to data. If a data breach affects you, we will notify you through your account email.
privacy.desc: This page explains how we process your personal data on revy.my.id.

terms.p2: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential. We may disable accounts that you use for abuse, spam, or illegal content without prior notice.
terms.p3: Articles, designs, and assets on this site belong to their respective owners. You may not copy or republish content from this site without written permission, unless we state otherwise (for example in the public tools).
terms.p4: We use data you submit through the contact form only to respond to your message, as we describe in the Privacy Policy.
terms.p5: We provide the tools and demo pages as is. We make no warranty of accuracy, availability, or fitness for a particular purpose. We do not advise you to run sensitive data through the public tools.
terms.p6: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect losses or loss of data resulting from use of this site.
terms.p7: We may change these terms at any time. You can always find the latest version on this page. We will announce significant changes on the homepage.
terms.p8: The laws of the Republic of Indonesia govern these terms.
terms.p9: If you have questions about these terms, contact M. Revi Ramadhan at revy8k@gmail.com.

about.title: About
